proposed_widenings.name: resource-less activated magic-item ability
proposed_widenings.justification: The item uses action-costed command words but does not consume charges, uses, or any resettable pool.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This item also has three command words, each requiring a Magic action to use.

proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item
proposed_widenings.justification: The transformation applies to the source item itself rather than a creature target or area.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The box unfolds into a Rowboat. The box unfolds into a Keelboat.

proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy.on_active_form_zero_hp
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's destruction is triggered by the vessel form reaching 0 Hit Points, not by charges or pool exhaustion.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If either vessel is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the Folding Boat is destroyed.

notes: Stopped before authoring content because the current magic-item activation surface cannot represent command-word activations with no resource/reset, the effect should attach to the item itself, and the destruction trigger is missing. The fold-back command also has a secondary missing precondition: "if no creatures are aboard."
